clue.text: Part of theatre for cleric worried by attire

clue.text: Accommodate. force

clue.text: This city within city that's constant?

clue.text: Just brilliant, losing head!

clue.text: Accommodation for busy workers

clue.text: Practical Greens seen to be troubled
